findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 The following general surfaces were observed soiled:
A) dairy shelving (mold/general buildup);
B) rolling milk cart - bottom rung (dried milk splash);  and
C) bottom inside soda cooler (mold/general buildup).
Nonfood contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to eliminate buildup of grease, food splash and general debris.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
6-202.14  Men's restroom door was not shutting properly as of the 1/10/19 routine inspection. Both are now gender neutral, and both doors did not seal flush with the door frame when allowed to self close. Repair the restroom doors so they shut and seal properly. 
All toilet rooms located within a food establishment must be enclosed with a tight-fitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.citation_text:
5-501.17 Women's restroom did not have a covered waste receptacle as of the 1/10/19 routine inspection. Both restrooms are now gender neutral, and neither has a covered waste receptacle. Covered waste receptacles are needed for items such as used diapers and feminine hygiene products.
Provide at least one covered waste receptacle in both restrooms.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 (A) Dust accumulation was observed on the ceiling in the walkin cooler by the condenser closest to the dairy section. Clean the ceiling in the cooler as needed to eliminate buildup.
-Mopsink basin and wall above the basin were soiled with general buildup and splash. Clean the mopsink and wall above the basin as needed to minimize buildup and splash.
Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-203.12  Hanging thermometer in the walkin cooler was reading approximately 10 degrees colder than the actual temperature. Cooler was observed at 39°F, while the hanging thermometer was reading around 29°F.  Manager was advised to replace the hanging thermometer with one that was reading accurately. 

Ambient air thermometers shall be accurate within +/-3°F in the intended range of use.

findings.citation_text:
5-501.17 Women's room did not have a covered waste receptacle.

Provide at least one covered trash receptacle in the women's restroom.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 (A) Dust accumulation was observed on the air exchange vent cover in the men's room and on the ceiling in the walkin cooler by the condenser closest to the dairy section. Clean the ceiling and vent cover in the aforementioned areas.

Floors were observed with a general accumulation of debris under stockroom shelves both upstairs and downstairs. Also, general debris and dead insects were observed around the stairs to the upstairs stockroom and the emergency exit by the stairs. Clean the floors in the aforementioned areas.

Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following items were observed to be soiled:
A) cooler section - plastic dividers used for storage of 11.5oz juices and 14oz milks (mold);
B) walkin cooler - bottom rung of rolling milk cart (dried splash);   and
C) energy drink/coffee & protein drink cooler - bottom under Monster and Red Bull cans (splash/mold).

Clean general surfaces in coolers, including Coke and Fannie May coolers, as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750.1110d - Covers were missing from restroom waste cans. Provide covered waste cans in restrooms.
 
Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floors in the following areas were observed to be soiled:
A) reach-in cooler section - under eggs and milk (food splash/debris; dead/dying ants);   and
B) walkin cooler - along back wall under shelving and storage racks (splash/debris).
Manager stated areas of concern would be addressed this evening.

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Dust accumulation was observed in the following areas:
A) men's room - air exchange vents;    and
B) walkin cooler - ceiling in front of condenser closest to the door.
Clean the aforementioned areas.

Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-130(d) Observed cartons of eggs being stored on the second to bottom shelf (over ready-to-eat foods/juices). Items were in the process of being moved during the inspection. Keep raw eggs and meats stored on the bottom shelf so any leaks and spills do not cross-contaminate ready-to-eat foods. All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Minimal mold growth is observed on the outer edges of some of the cooler shelves. The shelves holding juices in the middle, top of the first display cooler and the Pepsi aisle cooler are observed soiled. Clean the shelving. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 The ceiling air returns of both the mens and womens toilet rooms are observed soiled with accumulated dust. Clean the ceiling. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) Right as you walk into the store, the display island has a line of bagged chips on shelves attached at the lowest point on the unit and thus placing the food on the floor. Properly elevate that bottom shelf so food is stored a minimum six inches off the floor or high enough to allow for vacuuming. Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Bulk amounts of toilet paper, paper towels, and tissue are observed stored on the floor in the upstairs. See critical violation. Properly store these items six inches off the floor. There are tall plastic pallets available and some items are stored on these surfaces. Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 Observed mouse droppings along the entire floor-to-wall joint of the upstairs  beneath the shelving holding foods and around most of the facility. One of the mouse traps has a popped lid - no longer effective. Discussed what a mouse dropping looks like with manager. Discussed possible clean-up procedures. Clean the floors routinely to remove evidence of pests. Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 The floor beneath the shelving in the walk-in cooler is soiled with an accumulation of food and dirt debris. Also, the floor upstairs beneath the shelving is littered with candy, bags of chips, canned goods, and soil. Clean the floors. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210  The handsinks in the womens and mens toilet room is observed not properly caulked to the wall. Also, the mop sink in the back room is not properly caulked to the wall. Caulk the wall and then smooth caulking. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Broken glass and garbage debris were on the floor under the shelving units in the cooler.  Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
